wholePhysicalScope: The 49-point native outer perimeter and three courtyard polygons define the university. The museum’s tagged indoor coordinate and named address identify the photographed west entrance.
lodDetails: All four levels retain the native courtyards, Uriburu cultural center portal and Córdoba portico. Near views add rustication, arched sash and glazing, classical stone bands and cornices.
limitations: The 2010 west elevation is directly supported. Córdoba details, smaller court sections and most annex heights are estimates.
The university’s attached volumes are modeled as one exterior asset. The museum galleries are below street level, and the story anchor identifies them within the building.
